title: Reading spread, retelling
direction: A×C · Round 9 · /insights/the-17-percent-window · the note on paper
summary: The approved note (P07) as a reading page: the standfirst at 24px across cols 3–10, the reading column in cols 3–8 at 18px, the margin in cols 10–12 holding only sources and ‘What to look for’ in Mona, and one figure where the argument turns — ‘The retelling’, set in type: the note's two sentences through four hops (01 Demo → 02 Champion → 03 CFO → 04 Committee; order is the content), the mechanism intact, the promise (in --fg-2) losing words hop by hop to dashed rules that are red at the committee. The track of squares and arrowheads and the caps row keys are gone.
story: The argument itself, verbatim. Round 9 removes the apparatus that read as generated (glyph sidebars, caps note heads, boxed numerals, mono source links, the end square) and says each source once: the Gartner note sits beside the paragraph that calls it and is the only link to the study.

reference.site: Approved P07 (round 8) · Tailscale's blog article for the long-form measure
reference.borrowed: A long-form reading column with its sidenotes in a margin, one wide figure that breaks the column once.
reference.kelwin: Paper as the note's document surface; Mona everywhere but the numerals; the kit's segmented control, label and spec list.

motion: entrance: the reading column arrives with its slot; the figure plays once when 40% of it is in view (its own IntersectionObserver).
reduced motion: final state at once.
copy: Body [K] verbatim (approved P07), 83% throughout, with the standfirst moved here from the head; ‘Gartner’s buying research’ is named there, not linked (the source is linked once, in the margin)
Margin: source 1 (Gartner, linked) beside paragraph 2, where its call is; no gloss (the standfirst already gives 17% and 5%); ‘What to look for’ [K]; one pull quote [K] in the accent voice
Figure keys ‘A mechanism’ / ‘A promise’ and hop names in Mona
Cut: the layer-glyph key, the boxed numeral, the mono source link, the end square.
phone: ≤1023: the column takes cols 1–8 and the margin cols 9–12; the retelling hops stack on a left rule with a two-sample legend. ≤767: one column, each margin note right after its paragraph, the standfirst 20px, reading 17px. No overflow at 834 / 390 / 320; nothing under 11px.
notes: A reading surface, taller than the 1400px cap by design (the whole note). Margin notes take their own grid rows from their paragraph's row (no negative margins); ‘What to look for’ starts in its subsection heading's row and spans into empty trailing rows, so the paper always contains it. Stress-tested with notes grown 4×.
